title: Knowledge Commit Schema V1
description: Canonical schema for Knowledge Commit — the input/output contract for writing to the Knowledge-Memory Authority system.

kind.description: Memory kind. UNVERIFIED_INFERENCE is always routed to propose(), never directly committed.

key.description: Logical key for this memory entry. Used for deduplication and conflict detection.

mission_id.description: Parent mission ID. Required for mission-scoped memories.

source_evidence_id.description: Evidence artifact ID that backs this memory. REQUIRED for DECISION, FAILURE, FAILURE_EXPERIENCE, PATCH when mission-scoped.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key for idempotent write. Same key → same result. Required for Phase 2.

confidence.description: Confidence score. <0.8 routes to propose() instead of direct commit.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID linking this memory to a verified execution receipt. Phase 2 addition.

auto_commit.description: When true and confidence >= 0.8 and evidence-backed and no conflicts, commit directly without candidate review.

provenance.description: Origin descriptor: runtime, human, import, migration.
